semiconductor_relevance: High — Tomocube specializes in advanced 3D optical imaging technology for non-destructive analysis in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Tomocube, Inc. is a leader in holotomography, providing advanced 3D imaging solutions that enable non-destructive analysis of internal structures in semiconductor materials. Their technology allows for real-time defect detection and process optimization, enhancing yield and quality in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Holotomography for 3D imaging of internal structures
Non-destructive inspection of transparent and semi-transparent materials
Quantitative analysis of defects and structural parameters
Real-time monitoring of semiconductor fabrication processes
